testSummary.note: Cumulative across V4.1-V5.7. V5.7 added 31 new tests across 5 suites.

supportedClaims: Cupd d->K exponential is universal across N=60-80 (r < -0.95).
R1 state-conditioned suppressor is mostly robust (8/9 N).
V9 amplification is window-limited to N=64-70.
dRatio (<1 vs >1) perfectly predicts V9 role in transition region (100% at N=70-72).
N=71 is a sharp reduced-operator transition point.
100% shared-seed overlap between R1 failure and V9 flip at N=71.
Zero invalid runs across all conditions.
conditionalClaims: R1 suppression mostly robust (8/9 N at seeds 0-29). N=66 borderline, N=71 fails.
V9 amplification is N=64-70 window — not universal.
K->Omega mediation is N-conditioned — requires branch split (N>=64).
N=71 failure is finite-sample effect at 30-seed blocks (passes at 100 seeds).
